scope: Read-only frozen ARM64 ELF inspection. Actual CLI call edges and concrete sorting function-pointer flow; no target execution.
limits: Names alone are insufficient: this gate checks the actual CLI branch targets and sort pointer arguments.
Candidate retains uniqueness checks at each completed-group store and final store, plus conditional copy fallbacks.
Sorting scratch, parsed input arrays, capacity retention and generic fallback implementations remain; no zero-allocation or throughput claim.
The initial capture binary_unchanged field is not used as a stability proof; current hashes are independently matched to pre-test ordinary-release build receipts here.
